dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: Liyue tea is great, but it's hard to brew, and that's a headache for those who just want a quick drink.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have any suggestions?

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: Hah, I have an idea!

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: We'll break the leaves up into smaller pieces, then put them in a cloth or paper bag.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: And when you want tea, you can just put the bag in a cup and add water.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: You can even separate the tea leaves and the tea immediately after making it. Not bad, right?

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: Once I return to Fontaine after this deal, I'm going to put my invention into production right away.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: People in my line of work always have a lot of ideas, but I can't let them have this one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speed really isn't the goal when drinking tea, is it?

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: I've been doing business in Yilong Wharf for a decade, and I realized something...

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: Not everyone knows how to appreciate tea. Some aren't particular about the flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: It's unrealistic to ask them to spend a ton of time studying how to properly make the stuff. They'd find the step you need to wash the residue troublesome alone, to say nothing of the whole process.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: My tea bags are only for those who're looking for a quick cup. The traditionalists can still make tea the old-fashioned way. No one will be hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye, and good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: Farewell, you too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does this count as drinking tea?

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: Frankly speaking, this may not be the best way for those who are serious about tea.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: After all, the cloth and the paper bags will carry flavor all their own, which might affect the flavor of the tea in turn.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: Grinding the tea leaves too finely might also have an impact on the flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Hermanson
dialogues.text: We'll just have to keep trying to improve the paper or the cloth bags to minimize the aforementioned influence they might have.
